desc: Compute the `suff` array where `suff[k]` is the number of distinct integers in the suffix $A[k \dots N]$.
Compute the `next_occ` array where `next_occ[k]` is the index of the next occurrence of $A_k$ after index $k$ (or $N+1$ if it doesn't exist).
Initialize a Segment Tree to store values $V_j = distinct(A[i+1 \dots j]) + suff[j+1]$. Initially, compute these for $i=1$ (so middle is $A[2 \dots j]$) for all $j \in [2, N-1]$.

Implement the main loop: Iterate $i$ from $1$ to $N-2$, query the max in range $[i+1, N-1]$, update the global answer with $distinct(1, i) + \text{max\_val}$, and perform the range update on $[i+1, next\_occ[i]-1]$ by decrementing by 1.
Test the solution with the provided sample inputs and edge cases to verify correctness, specifically checking for off-by-one errors in the segment tree indices and range updates.
Run the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
